This is a senior-level software engineering role on Cloudflare's PKI and cryptographic infrastructure team, based in Austin, London, or Lisbon on a hybrid basis. The work covers certificate lifecycle management, X.509 issuance and validation, HSM integration, ACME-based issuance and renewal automation, Certificate Transparency, and Cloudflare's post-quantum cryptography migration — all at the scale of the TLS traffic Cloudflare terminates. The core stack is systems programming in Go, Rust, or C/C++, with PKCS#11 for HSMs, Postgres-style databases for high-integrity data, and distributed systems work on globally replicated services.
